description: This file defines the GrainVersioningOptions class within the Orleans.Configuration namespace. It specifies options related to grain versioning strategies in Orleans, including default compatibility and version selection strategies used in heterogeneous deployments.

classes.name: GrainVersioningOptions
classes.description: Provides configurable options for grain versioning strategies, including default strategies for compatibility and version selection in Orleans.

properties.name: DefaultCompatibilityStrategy
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of the default strategy used to determine grain compatibility in heterogeneous deployments.

properties.name: DefaultVersionSelectorStrategy
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of the default strategy for selecting grain versions in heterogeneous deployments.
